status: Derived research summaries only. Raw samples were examined via a live public GitHub connection; raw bytes are not shipped.
dataset_licensing: Raw redistribution not assumed; read DATA_PROVENANCE.md.
recompute_original_source: python tools/verify_public_references.py --download --output metrics_recomputed  (on a network-enabled machine)

adma.verification_status: AUTHENTIC SOURCE MEASUREMENTS ANALYZED VIA CONNECTED GITHUB (FULL 999 ROWS)
adma.validation_method: centered +/-5-sample heading difference; least-squares slope + intercept on <6.5s; remaining samples held out
evidence_limits: One 9.98s ADMA/INS recording; not an independent vehicle model-validation run
Comparing gyro to the derivative of heading measured by the same sensor system is not an independent ground truth
Yaw angle quantized to about 0.01 degree in published CSV; finite differences add differentiation noise
Small fitted correction is a diagnostic sensor agreement check; not tire stiffness, steering rack or yaw inertia
Raw CSV publication on GitHub does not clearly establish redistribution rights

civic.verification_status: ORIGINAL PUBLIC SEGMENT DATA INSPECTED VIA CONNECTED GITHUB
civic.reported_vehicle: Honda Civic (model/year/specifications unspecified in segment file)
evidence_limits: Strong agreement between reported a and derivative of v is not independent accelerometer validation; a may already have been derived from v
Nominal readme raw sampling is 100 Hz, but published segment t arrays average about 0.1 second (10 Hz)
Some segment index ranges overlap and can contain contradictory speeds; no independent-driver split has been validated
Published pedal signal mixes scale conventions (0..218); cannot use it to fit accelerator-to-torque maps
Readme claims MIT but links its license to a non-repository placeholder; no stand-alone LICENSE in root was verified
Observed p90 acceleration by speed represents driver demand and route, not a guaranteed full-throttle performance limit

bucknell_p1.status: research-identified best-estimate P1 parameters, NOT the in-game car
bucknell_p1.note: Yaw predictions are analytic bicycle-model computations from published estimated parameters, NOT road measurements.
